name: sort
description: Sort or merge records (lines) of text and binary files

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help message

options.name: --version
options.description: Displays the current version of sort

options.name: -c
options.description: Check that the single input file is sorted

options.name: --check
options.description: Check that the single input file is sorted

options.name: -C
options.description: Check that the single input file is sorted

options.name: -m
options.description: Merge only.  The input files are assumed to be pre-sorted.  If they are not sorted the output order is undefined

options.name: --merge
options.description: Merge only.  The input files are assumed to be pre-sorted.  If they are not sorted the output order is undefined

options.name: -o
options.description: Print the output to the output file instead of the standard output

options.name: --output
options.description: Print the output to the output file instead of the standard output

options.name: -S
options.description: Use size for the maximum size of the memory buffer

options.name: --buffer-size
options.description: Use size for the maximum size of the memory buffer

options.name: -T
options.description: Store temporary files in the directory dir

options.name: --temporary-directory
options.description: Store temporary files in the directory dir

options.name: -u
options.description: Unique keys. Suppress all lines that have a key that is equal to an already processed one

options.name: --unique
options.description: Unique keys. Suppress all lines that have a key that is equal to an already processed one

options.name: -s
options.description: Stable sort. This option maintains the original record order of records that have an equal key

options.name: -b
options.description: Ignore leading blank characters when comparing lines

options.name: --ignore-leading-blanks
options.description: Ignore leading blank characters when comparing lines

options.name: -d
options.description: Consider only blank spaces and alphanumeric characters in comparisons

options.name: --dictionary-order
options.description: Consider only blank spaces and alphanumeric characters in comparisons

options.name: -f
options.description: Convert all lowercase characters to their upper case equivalent before comparison

options.name: --ignore-case
options.description: Convert all lowercase characters to their upper case equivalent before comparison

options.name: -g
options.description: Sort by general numerical value

options.name: --general-numeric-sort
options.description: Sort by general numerical value

options.name: -h
options.description: Sort by numerical value, but take into account the SI suffix, if present

options.name: --human-numeric-sort
options.description: Sort by numerical value, but take into account the SI suffix, if present

options.name: -i
options.description: Ignore all non-printable characters

options.name: --ignore-nonprinting
options.description: Ignore all non-printable characters

options.name: -M
options.description: Sort by month abbreviations.  Unknown strings are considered smaller than the month names

options.name: --month-sort
options.description: Sort by month abbreviations.  Unknown strings are considered smaller than the month names

options.name: -n
options.description: Sort fields numerically by arithmetic value

options.name: --numeric-sort
options.description: Sort fields numerically by arithmetic value

options.name: -R
options.description: Sort by a random order

options.name: --random-sort
options.description: Sort by a random order

options.name: -r
options.description: Sort in reverse order

options.name: --reverse
options.description: Sort in reverse order

options.name: -V
options.description: Sort version numbers

options.name: --version-sort
options.description: Sort version numbers

options.name: -k
options.description: Define a restricted sort key that has the starting position field1, and optional ending position field2

options.name: --key
options.description: Define a restricted sort key that has the starting position field1, and optional ending position field2

options.name: -t
options.description: Use char as a field separator character

options.name: --field-separator
options.description: Use char as a field separator character

options.name: -z
options.description: Use NUL as record separator

options.name: --zero-terminated
options.description: Use NUL as record separator

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Specify maximum number of files that can be opened by sort at once

options.name: --compress-program
options.description: Use PROGRAM to compress temporary files (eg. bzip2)

options.name: --random-source
options.description: In random sort, the file content is used as the source of the 'seed' data for the hash function choice

options.name: --debug
options.description: Print some extra information about the sorting process to the standard output

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Set the maximum number of execution threads.  Default number equals to the number of CPUs

options.name: --files0-from
options.description: Take the input file list from the file filename

options.name: --radixsort
options.description: Try to use radix sort, if the sort specifications allow

options.name: --mergesort
options.description: Use mergesort.  This is a universal algorithm that can always be used, but it is not always the fastest

options.name: --qsort
options.description: Try to use quick sort, if the sort specifications allow.  This sort algorithm cannot be used with -u and -s

options.name: --heapsort
options.description: Try to use heap sort, if the sort specifications allow.  This sort algorithm cannot be used with -u and -s

options.name: --mmap
options.description: Try to use file memory mapping system call.  It may increase speed in some cases

options.name: --sort
options.description: Select how to sort values
